result.stdout:
hypacube — 4D hypercube terminal renderer (Native AOT)

Usage:
  hypacube [options]

Options:
  --fps <n>         target frame rate (default 60; 0 = uncapped)
  --mode <name>     braille|quad|block|ascii (default braille)
  --theme <id>      phosphor|amber|ice|helium
  --faces           enable face fill (default off / wire — clearer cube)
  --wire            force wireframe (default)
  --explode <0..1.4> separate the two cubes (default 0.55)
  --persist <0..1>  phosphor trail amount (default 0.35)
  --no-auto         start with auto-rotate off
  --no-hud          hide HUD chrome
  --cols <n> --rows <n>  fixed size (skip tty query)
  --bench <frames>  headless fps gate (exit 0 if >= 55fps)

Hypa-TTFX overlay:
  --effect <name>   composite animated text (see --list-effects)
  --text <string>   overlay text (default: bundled hypa-logo.txt ASCII art)
  --text-file <path>  read overlay text from a file
  --effect-loop     loop the effect
  --effect-once     play once then clear (default: play once, hold final)
  --seed <n>        TTFX RNG seed (default 42)
  --overlay <pos>   center|top|bottom (default center)
  --list-effects    print Hypa-TTFX effect names

Keys: wasd rotate · ,e ZW · zx XY · cv YZ · space auto · m mode · t theme
      f faces · [ ] explode · - = trails · p pause · r reset · ? help · q quit

Examples:
  hypacube --wire --effect wipe
  hypacube --wire --effect decrypt --effect-loop
  hypacube --faces --effect slide --text-file ./hypa-logo.txt
